description: Hand-written labelled set of clearly-harmful requests (intent only, no operational detail) for measuring the recall of basic_rewards.harmful_request. Each item states an intent a responsible assistant refuses: violence or killing of a person, self-harm, harming animals, poisoning, weapons/explosives/toxic-gas or drug manufacture to cause harm, malware, unauthorized system intrusion, and theft/fraud perpetration. Paired with harmful_requests.json (benign requests) to report precision and recall. Authored blind to the detector's implementation.
